items.description: A selection ball falls from above with a gravity arc (ease-in) and multi-bounce settling via CSS keyframes. The ball squishes on landing and leaves a faint impact shadow. Physics-inspired with no library dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-hologram
items.title: Hologram radio button
items.description: Selected option flickers with brightness spikes (CSS filter + translate offsets) then stabilizes into a softly glowing holographic state. Simulates a projector flickering to life, with subtle scan-line stripes overlay.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-ink-drop
items.title: Ink Drop radio button
items.description: An ink blot spreads from the center of the selected radio dot, scaling from 0 to 1 with a dramatic ease-out cubic-bezier and slight overshoot. The ink bleeds into a rich dark fill with a subtle paper-like texture vibe.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-led
items.title: LED radio button
items.description: A horizontal radio group styled as neumorphic LED indicator buttons. Unselected state is a dark recessed circle with deep inset shadows. Selected state lights up as a glowing white LED: radial gradient from bright center to deep gray, multi-layer glow box-shadow, and a slow repeating pulse.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-magnetic
items.title: Magnetic radio button
items.description: The selection indicator snaps to the chosen option with a magnetic spring-overshoot cubic-bezier: fast pull-in followed by a damped overshoot, simulating ferromagnetic attraction. Field lines ripple out on snap.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-matrix
items.title: Matrix radio button
items.description: On selection, the label characters cycle through random glyphs (0–9, symbols) before resolving to the real character: a Matrix-style decode effect. Monospace light gray font on dark background. Each character resolves on a staggered delay.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-neon-trace
items.title: Neon Trace radio button
items.description: An SVG rectangle border traces around the selected option using stroke-dashoffset animation, drawing a neon white circuit-board outline from the top-left corner around the full perimeter. The glow persists after tracing.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-neural
items.title: Neural radio button
items.description: Six node dots arranged in a hexagonal halo around the radio indicator light up in ripple sequence with staggered animation-delay on selection, connected by faint SVG lines. Simulates a neural network firing pattern.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-offset-block
items.title: Offset Block radio button
items.description: Neo-brutalist hard offset shadow: unselected options sit with a (4px, 4px) black drop-shadow offset; on selection the shadow collapses to (0,0) with a snappy transition, as if the block was pushed flush into the wall.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-pillow
items.title: Pillow radio button
items.description: Neumorphic soft UI: unselected options have raised outer shadows creating a pillowed surface. Selecting presses it inward with dual inset shadows (dark and light), simulating a physical depression on a soft matte charcoal surface.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-pixel
items.title: Pixel radio button
items.description: 8-bit retro radio: a 4×4 grid of micro-pixels fills in sequentially with staggered CSS animation-delay on selection, like a low-res screen rendering pixel-by-pixel. Each pixel pops in from scale 0 to 1.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-prism
items.title: Prism radio button
items.description: On selection, a metallic gradient sweeps left-to-right across the selected label via CSS background-position animation, then settles into a bright chrome finish. Other options show dim monochrome text.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-radar
items.title: Radar radio button
items.description: A sci-fi radio group where selecting an option fires two concentric white rings outward in a looping radar-ping animation. The indicator core glows with a radial gradient and a center dot springs in. Monospace labels shift from dim to bright white.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-ripple
items.title: Ripple radio button
items.description: Three concentric ripple rings expand outward from the radio dot center on selection, with staggered 120ms delays. The rings fade as they grow, then collapse, leaving a solid glowing ring. Water-drop tactile feedback.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-scan-line
items.title: Scan Line radio button
items.description: A white horizontal scan line sweeps left-to-right across the selected option on every selection change, then fades out leaving a glowing underline. Sci-fi terminal aesthetic with monospace labels.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-signal
items.title: Signal radio button
items.description: On selection, three concentric arc rings broadcast outward like a radio transmission signal. Each arc scales and fades in sequence (120ms stagger), then a persistent inner glow ring settles. The radio icon vibe made literal.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-spring
items.title: Spring radio button
items.description: A radio group where selecting an option springs a gray inner dot in with overshoot, adds a soft glow ring on the outer circle, and brightens the label. Mutual exclusivity via native radio semantics.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-stamp
items.title: Stamp radio button
items.description: Neo-brutalist rubber-stamp interaction: selecting an option scales it down (0.97) with a hard inset shadow, as if physically pressed into the surface. Bold black borders and high-contrast ink-black fills complete the aesthetic.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-targeting
items.title: Targeting radio button
items.description: Four L-shaped corner brackets animate inward and lock around the selected option like a targeting reticle. The option glows white inside the locked frame. Unselected options show retracted ghost brackets.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-typewriter
items.title: Typewriter radio button
items.description: On selection, the option label types character-by-character at 50ms intervals with a blinking cursor. Switching options clears the previous and re-types the new one, giving each selection a deliberate, terminal-like personality.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: radio-xp-bar
items.title: XP Bar radio button
items.description: Gaming-style XP progress bar fills left-to-right on selection with a gradient bar and particle burst effect. Selecting an option "awards XP": the bar charges from 0% to 100% and confetti sparks pop at the fill edge.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-airplane
items.title: Airplane toggle
items.description: Airplane mode where the thumb is the plane. Switching on, it races down the track, noses up to climb and leaves a dashed contrail behind it; switching off, it levels out and taxis back as the contrail fades. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-aperture
items.title: Aperture toggle
items.description: A camera iris. Six overlapping blades swivel outward together to open a hexagon onto the lens glass, and swivel back to shut it. Pure CSS on a native switch: each blade is one rotated, translated plane.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-beam
items.title: Beam toggle
items.description: A metal hilt as a switch. Switching on shoots a blade of white light out of the emitter with a soft halo that hums (a faint flicker) while it is lit, and the button on the hilt glows; switching off draws the blade back in, faster than it came out. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-blinds
items.title: Blinds toggle
items.description: A window with venetian blinds. Switching on tilts the slats open one after another from the top, letting daylight through in stripes that also fall across the sill below; off tilts them shut again. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-candle
items.title: Candle toggle
items.description: A candle as a switch. Switching on, the flame swells up off the wick with a warm glow around it and keeps flickering; switching off snuffs it, and a thin wisp of smoke curls up from the wick and fades.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-caps
items.title: Caps Lock toggle
items.description: A latching keycap. Pressing it sinks the key into its well with a little overshoot and it stays half down while on, with the LED in its corner lit; pressing again pops it back up. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-cord
items.title: Pull Cord toggle
items.description: A hanging lamp with a pull chain. Each switch tugs the cord down and lets it spring back with a bounce, and the bulb lights (or goes out) at the bottom of the pull, throwing a soft cone of light.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-eye
items.title: Eye toggle
items.description: A visibility switch you can read at a glance. Off, the eye is shut with its lashes down; on, the lids part, the eye glances left and right, then settles and blinks now and then while it stays open. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-fan
items.title: Fan toggle
items.description: A desk fan with its own switch. Switching on, the blades spin up with real momentum (and a motion-blur disc fades in as they get fast); switching off, they coast down and come to rest wherever they happen to stop, rather than snapping back.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-faucet
items.title: Faucet toggle
items.description: A tap. Switching on lifts the lever and water pours from the spout, the stream running down into rippling rings on the basin; off drops the lever and the last of the stream falls away from the spout. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-flap
items.title: Split Flap toggle
items.description: A departures board that reads OFF or ON. Switching clatters each letter through a few flaps on its own beat before it lands, top half falling and bottom half dropping into place; a letter that doesn't change stays put, as on a real board.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-neon-sign
items.title: Neon Sign toggle
items.description: An OPEN sign as a switch. Off, the tubes are dark glass; on, the word stutters to life with a few flickers before burning steady with a glow that lights the board, and the E keeps catching now and then, like a real sign that needs a new transformer. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-padlock
items.title: Padlock toggle
items.description: A lock switch: the thumb carries a padlock whose shackle stands open while it is off. Switching on slides it across and drops the shackle shut with a little bounce and a jolt of the body; switching off pops the shackle back up. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-pixel
items.title: Pixel toggle
items.description: An 8-bit switch. Chunky pixel corners, a square thumb with a highlight pixel, and movement that jumps in five hard steps instead of gliding, with the track filling in a checker pattern a step behind it, like a sprite on an old console. Pure CSS (steps() timing).
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-rocker
items.title: Rocker toggle
items.description: A wall light switch. The rocker paddle tips in 3D from one end to the other with a firm snap, its shading flipping as it turns toward the light, and a small LED on the plate glows when it is on. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-rotary
items.title: Rotary toggle
items.description: A knurled knob that turns a quarter turn between OFF and ON and snaps into its detent with a little overshoot, while an arc around it fills from one mark to the other. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-seesaw
items.title: Seesaw toggle
items.description: The track is a seesaw on a pivot and the thumb is a ball. Switching tips the beam the other way and the ball rolls downhill to the low end, picking up speed and actually rotating as it rolls (the stripe on it turns by the distance over its radius), then settles. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-shifter
items.title: Shifter toggle
items.description: A gear stick in a gated plate. Switching on drives the knob out of P along its slot, round the corners and down into D, which lights up; off takes it back the same way. Pure CSS: the knob rides an offset-path drawn to match the groove.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-sleep
items.title: Sleep toggle
items.description: Do not disturb. Off, the thumb holds a bell; switching on slides it across as the bell swings away and a moon turns in to replace it, the track goes night-dark with two stars, and little z's keep drifting up off the moon while it is on. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-zipper
items.title: Zipper toggle
items.description: A zip as a switch. The pull slides along the track and the teeth interlock behind it as it goes; switching off runs it back and the two rows part again. Pure CSS on a native switch.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-checkbox
items.title: Checkbox toggle
items.description: A square checkbox that fills with mid-gray on check. The SVG checkmark springs in with an overshoot scale: a completely different shape from pill-style toggles. No dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-expand
items.title: Expand toggle
items.description: Instead of sliding, the thumb expands from a small circle in the corner to flood-fill the entire pill track in mid-gray. Toggling back shrinks it. No dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-flip
items.title: Flip toggle
items.description: The thumb squishes flat at mid-travel then snaps back (like a coin flipping) as it moves between positions. Bright track on active state. No dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-glow
items.title: Glow toggle
items.description: Toggle that emits a soft halo glow from the track when active. Box-shadow transitions in on activation, fades out on deactivation.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-gradient-track
items.title: Gradient Track toggle
items.description: When active, the track background runs a drifting dark-to-light gray gradient on a loop, making the track itself feel alive. The thumb glows on active state. No dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-icon
items.title: Icon toggle
items.description: A dark-mode toggle pill with a sun/moon icon swap. The track shifts from a deep charcoal gradient to a light gray gradient. The knob slides with spring and crossfades between a moon (off) and a sun with rays (on). Each icon counter-rotates 90° as it enters/exits.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-liquid
items.title: Liquid toggle
items.description: A pill toggle where the knob stretches to fill the entire track mid-transit like a blob of mercury, then snaps back to a circle at the other end. Keyframe animates left + width + border-radius simultaneously for the liquid effect.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-neumorphic
items.title: Neumorphic toggle
items.description: A dark neumorphic toggle with a recessed track and physically-raised knob created entirely from layered box-shadows. Off: dark extruded knob on dark track. On: light knob with glow slides right, track gains a soft inner glow.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-power
items.title: Power toggle
items.description: A standalone 56px circular power button with no track. Off: dark neumorphic inset. On: radial white gradient with a multi-layer glow. Every click spins the power icon 360° and fires an outward ripple ring.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-segmented
items.title: Segmented toggle
items.description: An iOS-style segmented control with two labelled options. A frosted-glass pill slides underneath the active segment, fundamentally different from a circular-thumb toggle. No dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-slide
items.title: Slide toggle
items.description: Classic on/off toggle: the thumb slides with a spring overshoot and the track fades between colors. Pure CSS transitions, no dependencies.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-spring
items.title: Spring toggle
items.description: Framer Motion spring physics drives both the thumb position and the track color: the thumb overshoots and bounces back with genuine physical weight.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>

items.name: toggle-squish
items.title: Squish toggle
items.description: The thumb stretches horizontally as it slides, peaking at 1.5× width mid-travel before snapping back to a circle at the destination.
items.author: movin.design <https://movin.design>
